title: སངས་རྒྱས་ཅི་མཛད།
description: The Buddha's life journey through four sacred places: Lumbinī, Uruvilvā, the Deer Park, and Kuśīnagara.

chapters.title: ལུམ་བི་ནི
chapters.textTibetan:

སིད་དྷར་ཐ་ནི་སུའི་བུ་ཡིན།

chapters.title: རྡོ་རྗེ་གདན
chapters.textTibetan:

lineTranslations: Is Kuśīnagara a forest?
Kuśīnagara is not a forest.
Is Kuśīnagara a village?
Kuśīnagara is not a village.
What is Kuśīnagara?
Kuśīnagara is a city.
Is Kuśīnagara beautiful?
Is Kuśīnagara a beautiful city?
Kuśīnagara is a beautiful city.
What did the Buddha do in Kuśīnagara?
Was the Buddha born in Kuśīnagara?
The Buddha was not born in Kuśīnagara.
The Buddha was born in Lumbinī.
Did the Buddha attain enlightenment in Kuśīnagara?
The Buddha did not attain enlightenment in Kuśīnagara.
The Buddha attained enlightenment at Uruvilvā.
The Buddha attained enlightenment in a beautiful village.
Did the Buddha give the first teaching?
Did the Buddha give the first teaching in Kuśīnagara?
The Buddha did not give the first teaching in Kuśīnagara.
The Buddha gave the first teaching in the Deer Park.
What did the Buddha do in Kuśīnagara?
The Buddha passed away.
The Buddha passed away in Kuśīnagara.
The Buddha passed away in the beautiful city.
Born in Lumbinī, the Buddha passed away in Kuśīnagara.
Born in Lumbinī, having attained enlightenment at Uruvilvā, the Buddha passed away in Kuśīnagara.
Born in Lumbinī, having attained enlightenment at Uruvilvā, having given the first teaching in the Deer Park, the Buddha passed away in the beautiful city of Kuśīnagara.
